headline: PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery shares surge 35% in two days to hit a new high of ₹738.40
summary: PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery share price reached a new high of ₹738.40 in Thursday's trading session. The stock has surged 35 per cent over the past two days. It has also gained 125 per cent from its 52-week low of ₹328 recorded on March 30, 2026. Retail investors tracking jewellery stocks should note the sharp upward momentum in this counter.
why_it_matters: Sharp rally in small-cap jewellery stock draws momentum traders.
winners_losers: Existing shareholders gain / new buyers face volatility
